query: What data sources and weighting approach will quantify non-spatial barriers (language, awareness, safety, documentation fear) and how will these adjust demand/attendance probabilities?

response.query: What data sources and weighting approach will quantify non-spatial barriers (language, awareness, safety, documentation fear) and how will these adjust demand/attendance probabilities?
response.answer: Surveys and interviews can quantify non-spatial barriers, and logistic regression can adjust demand/attendance probabilities.

STUDENT ACHIEVEMENT The Coffeeville School District will provide individual student assessment reports to parents providing individual information on the level of achievement of the parent’s child in each of the state’s academic assessments.
